results.title: Donald Trump's approval rating

results.content: Approval of Trump’s handling of his job varies dramatically in line with the news sources to which people turn, due to both the content and the self-selected audience of each news organization. The audience of Newsmax gives the president an 85% job approval rating, followed by the Fox News audience at 68% approval. Among those who get news from podcasts, 58% approve of Trump. All other news source audiences give approval ratings below 50%, ranging from 47% for listeners of local radio to 14% [...] Among Republicans who approve of how Trump is handling his job, 82% approve of the Supreme Court, while among Republicans who disapprove of Trump, 43% approve of the Court. results.content:
Trump’s approval rating stands at 34%, while 64% of Americans say they disapprove of his job performance – unchanged since April. About seven-in-ten Republicans (69%) currently approve of his performance, while roughly three-in-ten (29%) disapprove. Democrats continue to overwhelmingly disapprove of his performance (93% disapprove, 6% approve).
